failure.cause: Calibration intercept and slope are obtained by iterative BFGS optimization. Recomputing them from the atomically published CSV probabilities can terminate a few optimizer steps differently from the in-memory calculation used by the runner because CSV serialization changes floating-point inputs below proper-score precision.
failure.authorized_repair: Use a field-specific absolute tolerance of 0.00005 only for calibration intercept and slope. Preserve the existing near-machine-precision tolerance for proper scores and intervals, and independently require the recomputed calibration gate booleans to match exactly.
